title: 第一章 一梦十万年第二章 这世界我来了
content_zh:
雄伟的大殿中，星主武书斜靠在王座上。
大殿之下，两人俯首在地，一名老者，一个年轻貌美女子。
此刻，大殿中气氛十分诡异，安静到了连一根针落下，都能被听到。如此，半个时辰过去了。武书方才是打破沉默道，“事已至此，你们二人难道已经没有什么话，想要说来听听吗？”
在大殿之中，老者二人受限很多，似乎有一股无形压力，压迫着他们。不说，他们在大殿中无法站直身体，即便是想开口说话，都很艰难。
而听到武书的话，女子真心想破口大骂，也想到眼下是阶下囚，女子艰难开口道，“星主，限制……。”
女子艰难说出限制二字时，武书方才是向他二人所在位置，随手一挥。紧接着老者二人便是感觉身体一轻，大口大口喘息着。
没有了束缚，老者恶语骂道，“武书，往日爷爷待你不薄，你竟敢如此对待爷爷？早知有今日，当初就该将你拍死在娘胎里。”
老者会有如此反应，武书并不意外，但敢公然直呼他的名字，还公然辱骂他，这种人武书是绝对不会容忍的。数万年来，积威已久，武书仅是平静的望向老者，老者便是不由浑身一个激灵。老者刚欲开口求放过，一道威压便是再次降临，老者整个人直接不受控制的趴伏在地。
看得出，老者也是一个相当有实力的强者，承受了星主武书的威压压迫，老者也仅仅只是口中溢出一丝鲜血。
武书平静道，“圣子山下，位置还有很多？我并不介意，再多将一个叛徒镇压在那里。”
圣子山作为遗忘大陆上的最高山脉，不仅地脉之力雄厚，更是有历代星主布下的法阵守护，星主之外，即便是达到星主级的神级强者，怕也是有去无回。
在选择与赵焚星合作时，老者便是想过自己可能有过的下场，但万万没想到，星主武书会想将他镇压在圣子山下。
一旦入了圣子山，不仅要承受圣子山下，各种大阵没日没夜的折磨，更会受到同在圣子山下的那个老东西的嘲讽。
老者欲言又止，一旁的赵焚星却是不屑道，“圣路难行，真想不明白，有如此心性，你又是如何修出圣印的。”
谈及武书的实力，特别是武书的悟性，身为武书的引路人，老者至今也想不明白，武书刚进入遗忘大陆时，天赋的确是很高，但那也仅限在玄力修炼方面。而法阵方面的领悟力，绝对算不上有多高。要知道，但凡能够进入遗忘大陆的少年，天资卓越只是他们能够进入遗忘大陆的底线，相比其他人，阵法一道上，从武书的开始表现来看，他在阵法方面的天资，绝对算是垫底的存在。
可任老者如何都未曾想到，如此一个废物，竟然会有一鸣惊人的一天。那一日，武书的爆发，直接是打破了遗忘大陆的规则。别人是，一朝明悟，天下知。星主武书却是一朝明悟，无敌手。
更加令老者没想到的是，从武书在阵法一道觉醒的那一刻算起，武书已经统治遗忘大陆九万九千九百多年。唉……还有那早先数十年，武书肯定是在装弱小，求保护。
赵焚星的话，星主武书并不想回答。因为十万年来，落败在他手中的天才，实在是太多。而不论是哪一种天才，在他们俯首在地后，皆是会问类似的问题。
但星主武书也是明白，若是没人回答赵焚星的问题。赵焚星一定会自认为受到了侮辱，接下来，必定会闭口不言，直接等待最终的死亡降临。人类中，强者毕竟会有强者的尊严。而身为神级强者，赵焚星当然也有自己该有的尊严。星主武书便是道，“武左，这个问题，你来回答。”
星主武书说话之时，老者身上无形压力便是莫名消失。

老者很不情愿的站起来，颇有情绪道，“武书，跟你说了多少次了？我是武右，圣子山下的那个老东西才是武左。”
王座上，星主武书没有想搭理武左的意思。
武左武右两兄弟，打从有记忆开始，便是争论谁大谁小。话说，这世间孪生兄弟姐妹的，论起大小来，怕是只有天知道，他们谁大谁小。
而一见星主武书手指开始在王座上敲打，武左立马道，“焚星，说起这圣印，必须先从圣路说起。圣路对于很多人来说，单单是听名字后，便是知道圣路难行。更别说，修行了。从传统意义上来说，圣路的起点，便是以人心善恶为开端，而光明所在的地方，便应该是圣路所通向的地方。”
“而遗忘大陆上的阵法师所走的圣路，严格来说，并不能单独算作世人口中的圣路。此圣路上，阵法师不仅要拥有圣念，更要有圣心。也只有拥有圣心的阵法师，才能够完美的使用好圣印。否则，即便你有资格成为阵法圣师，也只能领悟出圣印中的圣纹而已。”
说到圣印，赵焚星不由眉头一皱，明显不悦道，“圣心？为什么？你不早跟我说，能否驾驭圣印，由阵法师能不能修炼出圣心决定。”
说起这事，武左苦笑着摇头道，“阵法一途，本就是包容万千气象，你如今已经修炼出圣纹，又仅差一步便是能够成就圣印，圣印方面，想必你也有你自己的所想所悟。而在你的修行过程中，关于在圣印方面的所知，我也无不是跟你说过。唉……一切还是操之过急了。若是再给你十年时间，以你的天赋，在阵法方面，必然是能够超越星主武书的。”
“另外，阵法一途，星主武书可不仅仅只掌握了圣印，在道纹、不动明王印、鬼门、魔像等方面，星主皆是领悟精妙。”
赵焚星不敢相信道，“怎么会这样？这世间竟然会有人能够掌握如此繁多阵法。”
又是看向星主武书，赵焚星道，“不可能的，即便是神，也不可能将圣心、道心、佛念、鬼欲、魔心融合一体的。”
其实，赵焚星于武左所言，并非是赵焚星早先不清楚星主武书会有如此不可想象的实力。而之所以要当着星主武书的面，说这些话，赵焚星便是想通过从星主武书身上的微妙变化，来寻找星主武书身上的弱点。或者说，赵焚星希望从星主武书的言谈举止中，找到星主武书的修行根源，到底来自何处。
毕竟，身为人族，想要神魔同体容易。但想要同时，将各种相互抵触且互相绝对排斥的力量细化后，同时为己所用，才是最难的。
在星主武书看来，此时此刻，赵焚星与武左就是在演双簧，相比以往那些天才来说，赵焚星的演技更加传神一些罢了。
武书平静的看向赵焚星道，“你的问题，我已经回答你了。那么现在，换你来回答我的问题了。敢将我视为死敌，你的目的是什么？”
不等赵焚星回答，武书又道，“在回答我的问题前，我希望你想好自己的言词，否则，你会和死去的那些天之骄子一样，尸骨无存。”
如今的遗忘大陆上，武书绝对是第一强者。即便赵焚星自认实力很强，但与武书相比，赵焚星还是显得很弱小。而面对武书如此言语威胁，赵焚星却依旧不假思索道，“我会进入遗忘大陆，首要目的是为了确认一件事，厚土大陆上的天之骄子们，到底有没有谁，是值得我赵焚星在意的。”
“从有了记忆开始，我的身边并不乏天之骄子的同辈，只是让人遗憾的是，这么多天之骄子，想找到一个能够承受我三招之威的人都没有。无敌是多么的寂寞，这种寂寞，我相信，你现在也懂得。”
content_en:
In the majestic hall, Star Lord Wu Shu was leaning on the throne.
Under the main hall, two people bowed to the ground, an old man and a young and beautiful woman.
At this moment, the atmosphere in the hall was very strange, so quiet that even a pin dropping could be heard. In this way, half an hour passed. Wu Shu just broke the silence and said, "Now that the matter is over, don't you two have anything to say? Do you want to talk and listen?"
In the main hall, the two old men were very restricted, and there seemed to be an invisible pressure oppressing them. Not to mention, they couldn't stand up straight in the hall, and even if they wanted to speak, it was very difficult.
When she heard Wu Shu's words, the woman really wanted to curse. Also thinking that she was a prisoner, the woman spoke with difficulty, "Star Master, restrictions..."
When the woman struggled to say the word "restriction", Wu Shufang waved his hand towards the two of them. Immediately afterwards, the two old men felt their bodies become lighter and gasped for air.
Without the restraints, the old man cursed harshly, "Wushu, my grandfather treated you very well in the past, how dare you treat me like this? If you had known this, I should have killed you in your mother's womb."
Wu Shu was not surprised that the old man would react like this, but Wu Shu would never tolerate such a person who dared to openly call him by his name and openly insult him. Having accumulated prestige over tens of thousands of years, Wu Shu just looked at the old man calmly, and the old man couldn't help but feel excited all over. Just as the old man was about to open his mouth to beg for mercy, a wave of coercion came again, and the old man fell to the ground uncontrollably.
It can be seen that the old man is also a very powerful man. He withstood the coercion and oppression of the Star Lord's martial arts, and only a trace of blood spilled from the old man's mouth.
Wu Shu said calmly, "Are there many more places under the Holy Son Mountain? I don't mind if one more traitor is suppressed there."
As the highest mountain range in the Forgotten Continent, Saint Child Mountain not only has strong power of earth veins, but is also protected by magic formations set up by past Star Lords. Apart from Star Lords, even god-level experts who have reached the Star Lord level may never return.
When he chose to cooperate with Zhao Fenxing, the old man thought about his possible fate, but he never expected that the Star Master Martial Arts Society wanted to suppress him under the Holy Son Mountain.
Once you enter the Holy Son Mountain, you will not only have to endure the torture of various formations at the foot of the Holy Son Mountain day and night, but you will also be ridiculed by the old guy who is also at the foot of the Holy Son Mountain.
The old man hesitated to speak, but Zhao Fenxing on the side said disdainfully, "The holy road is difficult to walk. I really don't understand how you can cultivate the holy seal with such a mind."
When it comes to Wu Shu's strength, especially Wu Shu's understanding, as Wu Shu's guide, the old man still can't figure it out. When Wu Shu first entered the Forgotten Continent, his talent was indeed very high, but it was only in the cultivation of black power. And his understanding of the magic circle is definitely not that high. You must know that for any young man who can enter the Forgotten Continent, outstanding talent is only the bottom line for them to be able to enter the Forgotten Continent. Compared with others, in terms of formations, judging from the initial performance of Wushu, his talent in formations is definitely at the bottom.
But old man Ren never thought that such a waste would one day become a blockbuster. On that day, the outbreak of martial arts directly broke the rules of the Forgotten Continent. Others are like this. Once you realize it, the whole world will know it. However, Star Master Wushu once understood it and became invincible.
What the old man didn't expect even more was that from the moment Wu Shu awakened in the formation, Wu Shu had ruled the Forgotten Continent for more than 99,900 years. Sigh... And in those early decades, Wu Shu must have been pretending to be weak and asking for protection.
Star Lord Wu Shu didn't want to answer Zhao Fenxing's words. Because in the past 100,000 years, too many geniuses have fallen into his hands. No matter what kind of genius they are, they will always ask similar questions after they bow their heads to the ground.
But Star Lord Wu Shu also understood that if no one answered Zhao Fenxing's question.Zhao Fenxing will definitely feel that he has been insulted. Next, he will definitely keep silent and wait for the final death to come. Among human beings, the strong will have the dignity of the strong after all. As a god-level powerhouse, Zhao Fenxing certainly has the dignity he deserves. Star Lord Wu Shu said, "Wu Zuo, you answer this question."
When Star Lord Wu Shu spoke, the invisible pressure on the old man disappeared inexplicably.
The old man stood up reluctantly and said emotionally, "Wu Shu, how many times have I told you? I am Wu You, and the old guy at the foot of Shengzi Mountain is Wu Zuo."
On the throne, Star Lord Wu Shu had no intention of talking to Wu Zuo.
The two brothers Wu Zuo and Wu You have been arguing about who is older and who is younger since they can remember. In other words, among the twin brothers and sisters in this world, in terms of size, I am afraid only God knows who is older and who is younger.
When he saw Star Master Wu Shu's fingers starting to tap on the throne, Wu Zuo immediately said, "Burning Star, when talking about this Holy Seal, we must first talk about the Holy Road. For many people, just by hearing the name, they know that the Holy Road is difficult to walk, let alone practice. In the traditional sense, the starting point of the Holy Road is the good and evil of the human heart, and the place where the light is, should be where the Holy Road leads."
"Strictly speaking, the holy path followed by the formation masters on the Forgotten Continent cannot be counted as a holy road in the world. On this holy road, the formation masters must not only have the holy mind, but also the sacred heart. Only the formation masters with the sacred heart can perfectly use the holy seal. Otherwise, even if you are qualified to become the formation master, you can only comprehend the holy patterns in the holy seal."
Speaking of the Holy Seal, Zhao Fenxing couldn't help but frown, and said clearly displeased, "Sacred Heart? Why? If you didn't tell me earlier, whether you can control the Holy Seal depends on whether the formation master can cultivate the Sacred Heart."
Speaking of this, Wu Zuo smiled bitterly and shook his head and said, "The formation is meant to accommodate thousands of things. Now that you have cultivated the holy pattern, you are only one step away from achieving the holy seal. Regarding the holy seal, you must have your own thoughts and understandings. And in your case During my training, I told you everything about the Holy Seal. Alas... everything is too hasty. If you are given another ten years, with your talent, you will definitely be able to surpass the Star Master's martial arts. "
"In addition, in the formation process, the Star Master's martial arts not only mastered the holy seal, but also has a subtle understanding of Dao patterns, Fudo Mingwang Seal, ghost gates, demon statues, etc."
Zhao Fenxing couldn't believe it, "How could this happen? There are people in this world who can master such a variety of formations."
Looking at the star master's martial arts book again, Zhao Fenxing said, "It's impossible. Even a god can't fuse the Sacred Heart, the Taoist Heart, the Buddha's Thoughts, the Ghost Desires, and the Devil's Heart into one."
In fact, what Zhao Fenxing said to Wu Zuo was not that Zhao Fenxing was not aware of the unimaginable strength of the Star Lord Martial Arts Club earlier. The reason why Zhao Fenxing wanted to say these words in front of the Star Lord's martial arts book was because he wanted to find the weaknesses in the Star Lord's martial arts book through the subtle changes in the Star Lord's martial arts book. In other words, Zhao Fenxing hopes to find out where the Star Master's martial arts practice comes from from his words and deeds.
After all, as a human race, it is easy to have gods and demons in one body. But it is the most difficult to refine all kinds of conflicting and mutually exclusive forces at the same time and use them for oneself at the same time.
According to Star Master Wu Shu, at this moment, Zhao Fenxing and Wu Zuo are playing a double act. Compared with those geniuses in the past, Zhao Fenxing's acting skills are more expressive.
Wu Shu looked at Zhao Fenxing calmly and said, "I have already answered your question. Now, it's up to you to answer my question. What is your purpose if you dare to regard me as your mortal enemy?"
Without waiting for Zhao Fenxing to answer, Wu Shu added, "Before answering my question, I hope you will think about your words carefully., otherwise, you will be like the dead heroes of heaven, with no bones left. "
In today's Forgotten Continent, Wu Shu is definitely the strongest person. Even though Zhao Fenxing considers himself to be very strong, compared with Wu Shu, Zhao Fenxing still looks weak. Faced with such a verbal threat from Wu Shu, Zhao Fenxing still said without hesitation, "I will enter the Forgotten Continent. The first purpose is to confirm one thing. Among the proud people on the Thousand Earth Continent, are there any who are worthy of my attention, Zhao Fenxing." "
"Ever since I started to remember, I have been surrounded by my peers who are the proud ones. It's just a pity that there are so many proud ones, but I can't find anyone who can withstand the power of my three moves. How lonely it is to be invincible. I believe you understand this loneliness now. "
